checks.name: required_envelope
checks.description: Required fields 'id', 'text', 'entity_type', and 'tags' present in payload

checks.name: text_formatting
checks.description: Text is non-empty, stripped of unformatted whitespace, and properly sanitized

checks.name: vector_dimension
checks.description: Embedding vector matches expected dimension (64 elements)

checks.name: vector_unit_norm
checks.description: Embedding vector L2 norm equals 1.0 within tolerance (+/- 0.005)

checks.name: score_bounds
checks.description: Cosine similarity or relevance score is within [-1.0, 1.0]
